name: @epoch/adapter-mcp
description: Epoch External Tool adapter (W029 reference set) — the typed, provider-neutral reference adapter for external tool protocols (action + evaluator categories): tool discovery derives typed W007 capability-registration documents (tool invocation surfaces); tool invocation builds deterministic W003 action proposals admitted EXCLUSIVELY through the W022 action-gateway seam (policy decision first — allow / deny / requires-approval — then the authority's typed outcome records; the adapter holds NO credentials, executes NOTHING itself, and never bypasses the gateway — gateway-bypass-rejected and credential-rejected typed). The evaluator surface judges recorded tool-invocation outcomes against declared criteria with mandatory justification. Provider vocabulary stays in src/provider (blocklist-tested). In-memory reference behavior: NO network, NO live tool calls, NO real side effects; fixtures stand in for provider payloads.
